data.one_liner: An AnimatedList that automatically computes item deltas and animates list changes.
data.what_it_does: AutomaticAnimatedList takes an underlying list of items and a keying function, automatically computing the differences using diffutil_dart when the list updates. It then triggers insertion and removal animations for the list tiles without requiring manual AnimatedListState calls.
use_when: You have a dynamic list of items that frequently updates and you want automatic animations.
You want to avoid manually managing AnimatedList insertion and removal states.
avoid_when: You are not using a list structure that benefits from diff-based animations.
You need custom imperative control over every single list animation step.
strengths: Automatically computes item deltas on list updates.
Simplifies AnimatedList usage by eliminating manual state manipulation.
weaknesses: Relies on the provided keying function to accurately track items.
